{"program":"domain(person,[lakelynn,steven,orion,brayan]).
% Lakelynn does not regain confidence.
axiom(s1, not(regain_confidence(lakelynn))).
% Steven does not practice mindfulness.
axiom(s2, not(practice_mindfulness(steven))).
% Steven does not seek medical attention.
axiom(s3, not(seek_medical_attention(steven))).
% Orion is physically inactive.
axiom(s4, physically_inactive(orion)).
% If Orion's patients feel better, then they regain confidence.
axiom(s5, rule([patients_feel_better(orion)], patients_regain_confidence(orion))).
% If Steven's patients feel better, then they regain confidence.
axiom(s6, rule([patients_feel_better(steven)], patients_regain_confidence(steven))).
% If Steven's patients experience symptoms, then they either find a support network or overcome depression (or both).
axiom(s7, rule([patients_experience_symptoms(steven)], or(patients_find_support_network(steven),patients_overcome_depression(steven)))).
% Steven's patients manage stress or overcome depression.
axiom(s8, or(patients_manage_stress(steven),patients_overcome_depression(steven))).
% If Lakelynn's patients get medical treatment and follow their prescription, then they can overcome depression.
axiom(s9, rule([patients_get_medical_treatment(lakelynn),patients_follow_prescription(lakelynn)], patients_overcome_depression(lakelynn))).
% Steven does not regain confidence.
axiom(s10, not(regain_confidence(steven))).
% Steven either has a debilitating condition or leads a healthy lifestyle, but not both.
axiom(s11, xor(has_debilitating_condition(steven),leads_healthy_lifestyle(steven))).
% Lakelynn does not seek medical attention.
axiom(s12, not(seek_medical_attention(lakelynn))).
% If someone stays positive, then they can improve their mental health.
axiom(s13, rule([stays_positive(X)], improve_mental_health(X))).
% Steven either leads a healthy lifestyle or is physically inactive, but not both.
axiom(s14, xor(leads_healthy_lifestyle(steven),physically_inactive(steven))).
% Steven does not lead a balanced life.
axiom(s15, not(leads_balanced_life(steven))).
% Lakelynn's patients manage stress or overcome depression.
axiom(s16, or(patients_manage_stress(lakelynn),patients_overcome_depression(lakelynn))).
% If Steven either manages stress or practices mindfulness (but not both), then he leads a balanced life.
axiom(s17, rule([xor(manage_stress(steven),practice_mindfulness(steven))], leads_balanced_life(steven))).
% Steven is physically inactive.
axiom(s18, physically_inactive(steven)).
% For anyone who has a support system and engages in hobbies, they can manage stress.
axiom(s19, rule([has_support_system(X),engages_in_hobbies(X)], manage_stress(X))).
% Everyone who has a debilitating condition either seeks medical attention or takes medicine (or both).
axiom(s20, rule([has_debilitating_condition(X)], or(seek_medical_attention(X),take_medicine(X)))).
% For anyone who eats nutritious food and exercises regularly, they can lead a healthy lifestyle.
axiom(s21, rule([eats_nutritious_food(X),exercises_regularly(X)], leads_healthy_lifestyle(X))).
% If someone takes medicine and improves their mental health, then they feel better.
axiom(s22, rule([take_medicine(X),improve_mental_health(X)], feel_better(X))).","query":"labelled_explanation(implies(patients_get_medical_treatment(steven),patients_improve_mental_health(steven)),Status,Package)"}
